## `startReview` orchestration (lines 903-1413)

### 1. Setup and diff fetching
`startReview` (line 903) calls `getPrDetail` (`gh-cli.ts`) to fetch PR metadata (SHAs, branches, title). It calls `ensureReviewSeries` to upsert a `pr_review_series` row (`db.ts`/`sqlite-adapter.ts`), then `getLatestSuccessfulReviewBaseline` to decide whether to run `'full'` or `'incremental'` mode. A new `pr_reviews` row is inserted immediately with status `'running'`.

### 2. Scope resolution and diff chunking (inside `runParallelReview`, line 1017)
`createPrWorktree` creates a temporary git worktree via `git fetch` + `git worktree add` for accurate code-at-head context.

`resolveReviewScope` (`review-scope.ts`) computes the effective diff: for incremental mode it diffs only from the previous review's headSha; for full mode it diffs the whole PR. It returns the files list and scoped diff text.

`getTokenBudget` + `chunkDiff` (`diff-chunker.ts`) split the diff into context-window-safe chunks, logging skipped files (lock files, generated code).

### 3. Context building (`pr-context/`)
A `PrContextBuilder` (`pr-context/pr-context-builder.ts`) is instantiated with two backends:
- `McpContextBackend` (`pr-context/mcp-context-backend.ts`) using `CodeIntelligenceMcpClient` (`pr-context/mcp-client.ts`) if a code-intelligence MCP server is configured (resolved via `pr-review-mcp-config.ts`).
- `HeuristicContextBackend` (`pr-context/heuristic-context-backend.ts`) as the fallback.

`builder.build(...)` runs with a 20s total timeout and emits `IPC.GH_REVIEW_CONTEXT_UPDATE` events to the renderer.

### 4. Parallel specialist agents
One `runAgentSession` call is launched per focus area (security, bugs, performance, etc.) via `Promise.allSettled`. Each agent:
- Creates a session via `sessionManager.createSession` (`session-manager.ts`) using the resolved model/provider/effort.
- Passes the MCP config so the agent gets code-intelligence tools.
- Iterates diff chunks, building prompts with `buildPrReviewFirstChunkPrompt` / `buildPrReviewContinuationPrompt` (`pr-review-prompts.ts`), sending each via `sessionManager.sendMessage`.
- Accumulates streamed text via `extractReviewOutputText`/`appendReviewOutputText` (`pr-review-output.ts`).
- Parses findings from the collected text via `parseFindings` (internal method).
- After completion, tallies MCP tool calls with `countMcpToolUses` (`pr-review-prompts.ts`) for telemetry.

The worktree is removed after all agents finish.

### 5. Deduplication
All findings from every agent are merged and passed to `deduplicateFindings` (`pr-review-dedupe.ts`), which clusters near-duplicate findings deterministically.

### 6. Critic pass (`runCriticPass`, line 1458)
Uses `partitionForCritic` to split findings into auto-kept (blocker/high severity anchored findings) and candidates. `buildCriticPrompt` + `parseCriticVerdicts` + `applyCriticVerdicts` (`pr-review-critic.ts`) run a lightweight LLM pass on candidates via `sessionManager.sendGitAiQuery`. If the primary provider fails, it retries with the peer provider (`resolvePeerReviewAgent`).

### 7. Peer review pass (`runPeerReviewPass`, line 1515)
`resolvePeerReviewAgent` picks the opposite provider (Claude primary → Codex peer, and vice-versa). `buildPeerReviewPrompt` + `parsePeerReviewChanges` + `applyPeerReviewChanges` (`pr-review-peer-review.ts`) run the second-opinion session, then `deduplicateFindings` is run again on the merged result.

### 8. Thread lifecycle and revalidation
`assignFindingThreads` fingerprints each finding (`domain|file|lineBucket|title`) and upserts `pr_review_threads` rows, tagging each finding as `new` or `persisting`.

For incremental reviews, `runRevalidationPass` (`revalidation-worker.ts`, dynamically imported) re-checks threads whose files were touched in this diff but not surfaced as new findings, issuing `revalidation-session` LLM calls.

`applyThreadLifecycle` generates synthetic `resolved`/`needs_revalidation`/`persisting` entries for threads not matched in this run.

- Fires a `GH_REVIEW_UPDATE` IPC event to unblock the renderer immediately, then hands off to `runParallelReview(...)` fire-and-forget (`.catch` handles error status).

- `createPrWorktree(repoPath, prNumber, headBranch, reviewId)` (private method, same file, calls `git-worktree-service.ts`) checks out the PR head in an isolated worktree at `~/.pylon/worktrees/`. Falls back to `repo.projectPath` on failure.
- `resolveReviewScope({ repoPath, current, previous, requestedMode })` from `src/main/pr-review-manager.ts` (imported inline via `out/main/index.js` lines 11599-11636): computes the final `diff`, file list, and confirmed `reviewMode` (`full` or `incremental`). ---

### 3. Diff chunking (lines 1065-1079)

- `sessionManager.getModelContextWindow(model)` queries the SDK-reported context window for the chosen model.
- `getTokenBudget(undefined, 0, contextWindow)` (same file) computes a safe token ceiling by subtracting prompt overhead.
- `chunkDiff(scopedDetail.diff, { tokenBudget })` (from `src/main/diff-chunker.ts`) splits the diff into token-safe chunks and returns a list of skippable files (lock files, generated code, etc.).

---

### 4. Context building (lines 1125-1203)

Two backends are constructed:

- `HeuristicContextBackend` (from `src/main/pr-context/heuristic-context-backend.ts`): pure-regex/AST heuristics for symbols and references.
- `McpContextBackend` (from `src/main/pr-context/mcp-context-backend.ts`): wraps `CodeIntelligenceMcpClient` to query the code-intelligence MCP server for rich symbol/reference data.

`PrContextBuilder` (from `src/main/pr-context/pr-context-builder.ts`) orchestrates both. It calls `builder.build({ diff, worktreePath, pr, totalTimeoutMs: 20_000 })` and emits a `GH_REVIEW_CONTEXT_UPDATE` IPC event with phase `building` / `done` / `fallback` / `error`. Context is **not passed directly to agents** -- it is written into the worktree/MCP context that agents can query at runtime.

---

### 5. Parallel specialist agents (lines 1205-1225)

```ts
const agentPromises = focusAreas.map((focus) =>
  this.runAgentSession(reviewId, reviewCwd, scopedDetail, chunks, skippedFiles, focus, active, mcpConfig, reviewAgent)
)
results = await Promise.allSettled(agentPromises)
```

Each `focus` (e.g. `security`, `correctness`, `performance`, `style`) gets its own `runAgentSession` call (private method, same file, lines ~12757-12848 in compiled output). Each session creates an agent via the provider layer (`src/main/providers/`, resolved by `getProviderForModel`), passes the diff chunks, and streams findings back. Findings are accumulated per agent. The worktree is cleaned up (`removePrWorktree`) once all settle.

---

### 6. Deduplication (line 1249)

`deduplicateFindings(allFindings)` from `src/main/pr-review-dedup.ts`: groups findings by `file:line`, clusters by title similarity via `clusterByTitleSimilarity`, merges each cluster with `mergeCluster`, then calls `mergeNearLineDuplicates` for findings within ±3 lines of each other.

### 7. Critic pass (line 1253)

`runCriticPass(reviewId, cwd, deduped, reviewAgent)` (private, same file, ~lines 12596-12633): runs a single LLM session that re-reads all deduplicated findings and prunes or downgrades low-signal ones. Returns the filtered set.

---

### 8. Peer review pass (lines 1254-1260)

`runPeerReviewPass(reviewId, cwd, scopedDetail, filtered, reviewAgent)` (private, same file, ~lines 12634-12756): another LLM session acting as a second-opinion reviewer. It applies `normalizeSuggestion` (from `src/main/pr-review-peer-review.ts`) to clean up inline code-suggestion ranges and returns a refined finding list.

---

### 9. Thread lifecycle + revalidation (lines 1261-1323)

- `assignFindingThreads(reviewId, peerReviewed)` (private, same file): matches findings to existing `pr_review_threads` rows by fingerprint, marking them `new`, `persisting`, or `resolved`.
- For incremental reviews, `runRevalidationPass(...)` from `src/main/revalidation-worker.ts` is dynamically imported. It calls `selectThreadsToRevalidate` to identify old open threads touching the same files, runs a `runRevalidationSession` for each, and returns verdicts (`resolved`/`persisting`/`stale`). Resolved threads auto-post resolutions via `resolveMappedCommentsForOutcomes` (from `src/main/gh-cli-review.ts`).
- `applyThreadLifecycle(reviewId, reviewMode, touchedFiles, allAssignments)` merges explicit and revalidation assignments into the final `threadedFindings` array with `statusInRun` set.

---

### 10. Persistence and completion (lines 1326-1400)

- Each `ThreadedFinding` is inserted into `pr_review_findings` via `getDb()` / `sqlite-adapter.ts`.
- `sumAgentCosts(active)` tallies cost across all agent sessions.

Here is the full orchestration walkthrough:

---

## `startReview` orchestration (lines 903-1413)

### 1. Setup and DB insertion (lines 903-990)

`startReview` creates a UUID review ID, calls `getPrDetail` (`gh-cli.ts`) to fetch head/base SHAs, and determines whether to run `full` or `incremental` mode by checking `getLatestSuccessfulReviewBaseline` against a review series. It inserts a `running` row into `pr_reviews` via `getDb()` (`db.ts`), registers an `ActiveReviewSession` in `this.activeReviews`, and fires an initial `IPC.GH_REVIEW_UPDATE` to the renderer. The long-running work is then launched fire-and-forget via `this.runParallelReview(...)`.

---

### 2. Worktree + scope resolution (lines 1037-1079)

`runParallelReview` creates an isolated git worktree with `createPrWorktree`, then calls `resolveReviewScope` (`review-scope.ts`) to compute the actual diff and file list (honoring `full` vs `incremental`). The result feeds `chunkDiff` (`diff-chunker.ts`) which splits the diff into token-budget-aware chunks, skipping lock files and generated code.

---

### 3. Context building (lines 1125-1203)

A `PrContextBuilder` (`pr-context/pr-context-builder.ts`) is constructed with two backends:
- **`McpContextBackend`** (`pr-context/mcp-context-backend.ts`) backed by `CodeIntelligenceMcpClient` (`pr-context/mcp-client.ts`) for semantic symbol/reference context.
- **`HeuristicContextBackend`** (`pr-context/heuristic-context-backend.ts`) as the fallback.

`builder.build()` is called with a 20-second total / 8-second per-call timeout. It tries MCP first; on failure it falls back to heuristic and writes a `degraded` bundle. The result is written to `.pylon/pr-context.json` in the worktree and a `GH_REVIEW_CONTEXT_UPDATE` IPC event is sent.

---

### 4. Parallel specialist agents (lines 1205-1246)

One `runAgentSession` call is made per `focusArea` (e.g. security, logic, style) and all are raced with `Promise.allSettled`. Each agent runs as a provider session via `sessionManager` (`session-manager.ts`) and `getProvider`/`getProviderForModel` (`providers/registry.ts`). Each agent gets the chunked diff and the context bundle. Results are `ReviewFinding[]` arrays.

---

### 5. Dedupe and critic pass (lines 1249-1253)

All findings are merged, then `deduplicateFindings` (`pr-review-dedupe.ts`) removes near-duplicates deterministically. The deduplicated list is then passed to `runCriticPass` (line 1458 in the same file), which runs another agent session as a critic that can suppress low-quality findings.

---

### 6. Peer review pass (lines 1254-1260)

`runPeerReviewPass` (line 1515) runs a second-opinion agent session that reviews the filtered findings against the full diff and can upgrade/downgrade severities or add notes.

---

### 7. Thread assignment and incremental revalidation (lines 1261-1323)

`assignFindingThreads` (line 744) fingerprints findings and matches them to existing `pr_review_threads` in SQLite. For incremental runs, `runRevalidationPass` (`revalidation-worker.ts`, dynamically imported) checks whether previously open findings in touched files are still present, resolved, or stale, and writes verdicts back to `pr_review_threads`. `applyThreadLifecycle` (line 838) then assigns `statusInRun` (`new`/`persisting`/`resolved`/`stale`) to each finding.

---

### 8. Persistence (lines 1326-1378)

All findings are inserted into `pr_review_findings` via a prepared statement using `getDb()` (`db.ts`). Cost is summed from all agent sessions, a `ReviewRunSummary` is built, and `pr_reviews` + `pr_review_series` are updated to `done`. The final `GH_REVIEW_UPDATE` IPC event is sent to the renderer with all findings, cost, mode, and per-agent progress.

---

### Supporting modules summary

| Step | Module |
|---|---|
| PR detail fetch | `gh-cli.ts` (`getPrDetail`) |
| Scope / diff | `review-scope.ts` (`resolveReviewScope`) |
| Diff chunking | `diff-chunker.ts` (`chunkDiff`, `getTokenBudget`) |
| Context building | `pr-context/pr-context-builder.ts`, `mcp-context-backend.ts`, `heuristic-context-backend.ts`, `mcp-client.ts` |
| Agent sessions | `session-manager.ts`, `providers/registry.ts` |
| Dedupe | `pr-review-dedupe.ts` (`deduplicateFindings`) |
| Persistence | `db.ts` (`getDb`) |
| Revalidation | `revalidation-worker.ts` (`runRevalidationPass`) |
| IPC events | `shared/ipc-channels.ts` (`IPC.GH_REVIEW_UPDATE`, `IPC.GH_REVIEW_CONTEXT_UPDATE`) |
